fields.title: Python Basics
fields.description: Master the fundamentals of Python programming. This comprehensive course covers variables, data types, control structures, functions, and object-oriented programming. Perfect for beginners who want to start their programming journey.

fields.title: Django Web Development
fields.description: Build production-ready web applications using Django. Learn MVC architecture, ORM, authentication, API development, and deployment. This course is ideal for developers who want to create scalable web applications.
fields.short_description: Build web applications with Django framework

fields.title: React.js Fundamentals
fields.description: Learn to build interactive user interfaces with React.js. Master components, hooks, state management, routing, and integrating with APIs. Create modern web applications with one of the most popular JavaScript libraries.
fields.short_description: Master modern UI development with React

fields.title: Advanced Python
fields.description: Deep dive into Python advanced concepts. Master decorators, generators, context managers, metaclasses, and async programming. This course is for experienced Python developers who want to level up their skills.

fields.title: Data Science with Python
fields.description: Transform raw data into actionable insights. Learn data manipulation with Pandas, visualization with Matplotlib and Seaborn, statistical analysis, and machine learning basics with scikit-learn. Perfect for aspiring data scientists.
fields.short_description: Data analysis and visualization with Python

fields.title: JavaScript ES6+
fields.description: Master modern JavaScript. Learn ES6+ features, functional programming, promises, async/await, and best practices. This course provides the foundation you need for any JavaScript framework or environment.

fields.title: Full-Stack Web Development
fields.description: Become a full-stack developer. Master both frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React) and backend (Django, databases, APIs). Build complete web applications from database to user interface.
fields.short_description: Complete guide to full-stack web development

fields.title: Mobile App Development with Flutter
fields.description: Build beautiful and fast native mobile applications for iOS and Android using Flutter. Learn Dart programming, UI design patterns, state management, and app deployment. Create your first app in weeks, not months.
